question: Who became the first woman soldier skydiver of the Indian Army to have jumped from a height of 10,000 feet?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lance Naik Manju.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** first woman** soldier **skydiver** of the Indian Army to have jumped from a height of **10,000 feet** is** Lance Naik Manju.**
 
• She accomplished this feat in **2019** during the Army Day celebrations in Delhi.
 
• Lance Naik Manju is a member of the **Indian Army's Army Service Corps** and is based in **Bengaluru.**
 
• This achievement is significant as it breaks **gender stereotypes** and encourages more women to join the armed forces.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lieutenant General **Madhuri Kanitkar** is the** third woman officer **in the Indian Army to hold the rank of Lieutenant General.

 
 
• She was promoted to this rank in **2019** and is currently serving as the **Deputy Chief of Integrated Defence Staff **(Medical).
 
 
 
• Lieutenant General **Rajshree Ramasethu** is also a high-ranking woman officer in the Indian Army.
 
 
• She was the first woman officer to be appointed as a **Judge Advocate General **(JAG) in the Indian Army.
 
 
 
• Air Marshal **Arti Sarin **is the first woman officer to hold the rank of Air Marshal in the Indian Air Force.
 
 
• She retired in 2019 after serving for **37 years.**
